source_evidence: The financial strength of the insurance company that issues the policy backs all guarantees, including the death benefit. If the insurance company experiences financial distress, it may not be able to pay what it owes you under the policy.
question: Misconception: The insurer’s death-benefit guarantee means beneficiaries will definitely be paid, regardless of the insurer’s financial condition.
answer: The guarantee depends on the issuing insurance company’s financial strength. If the company experiences financial distress, it may not be able to pay what it owes under the policy.
